speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: Without what no pot?
premises: Without that (tat vinā) — without potter (kumbhakāreṇa) — even a pot (ghaṭo'pi).
inference: No pot without potter: how else could it be?

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: What of clay-lump nature?
premises: From the pradhāna-made clay-lump (pradhānamayamṛtpiṇḍāt) indeed (eva) — of such nature (tādṛksvabhāvataḥ).
Now (atha): own-nature (svabhāvaḥ) — this (eṣaḥ) of this (asya) — which (yat) looks to potter and the rest (kulālādi apekṣaṇam).
inference: Own-nature looks to potter etc.: clay-lump nature potter-watching.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: Can helpers entering matter arrange?
premises: Not (na) indeed (eva): by entering (praveśāt) inside the material cause (upādānahetvantaḥ), with helpers (sahakāribhiḥ).
Arrangement (saṃniveśaḥ) could (śakyaḥ) be made (kartum), they say (iti) — though able (kṣamam).
Prose: entering doesn't transfer arrangement-making; helpers stay helpers.
inference: Entering matter with helpers can't make arrangement — ability aside.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: Without what wisdom?
inference: Hemistich as printed: without world-linked wisdom — never.
uncertainties: Hemistich (cd lost in print); nothing restored.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: Without desiring?
premises: So (tathā), without (vinā) desiring-to-make (cikīrṣāṃ), no wondrous-making arising (vicitraracanodbhavaḥ).
There'd be mere grossness (sthūlatāmātram), not (na) world-useful (lokopayoginī) — but (tu).
inference: No will, no wonders: mere grossness, never world-good.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: If from potter-helping?
premises: Making (racanā) by rule (niyamena) would be (syāt) wondrous (vicitrā), kind-formed (jātirūpiṇī).
If (cet) from potter-helping-mereness (kulālasahakāritvamātrāt) a pot is born (jāyate ghaṭaḥ).
inference: Conditional: rule-wondrous making — if mere potter-help bore pots.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: What of bodies and arrangement?
premises: Never (na) would there be (syāt) body etc. (śarīrādi) — long clay-lump (dīrghamṛtpiṇḍa) or (vā).
Hence (atas) indeed (eva): by being-led-to-the-end (arthanīyatvāt), arrangement (saṃniveśaḥ) excels (viśiṣyate).
inference: No bodies otherwise; end-led arrangement excels.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: Lord or non-Lord?
premises: Not (na) by pot-etc.-ness (ghaṭāditayā) proved (siddhaḥ) — the need-fulfiller (arthitāparipūrakaḥ).
Neither Lord (īśvaraḥ) nor non-Lord (anīśvaraḥ) is taken (prakṛtaḥ) here (atra) as atomic-marked (aṇulakṣaṇaḥ).
inference: Both extremes fenced: neither Lord nor un-Lord atomically taken.

speaker: Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)
question: Does pradhāna will?
uncertainties: na-scope ambiguous (denies arising? or denies puruṣārthatā?); read as fencing will off pradhāna, keeping puruṣārthatā — held open.
